cards.question: Strikethrough Text Generator
cards.qualifier: Cross out or underline text with five Unicode styles and paste it into Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and other apps that have no strikethrough button.

groups.label: Price drops and sales
groups.text: Show the discount at a glance, with a plain-text description too.

groups.label: Jokes and self-corrections
groups.text: Cross out the honest word, then add the polite one.

groups.label: Checklists and updates
groups.text: Strike finished items in a pinned post or a bio list.

groups.label: Underlined emphasis
groups.text: Make a single word, such as a deadline, stand out.
